title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Noether record: Spanish and Japanese through Paper 43 complete, RA03 cumulative correction
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The top-level PDFs expose source-checkable German modern LaTeX, English high-fidelity translations, and current multilingual translation pilots.

Status at a glance. Numbered-paper German/English stream: Papers 1-43 complete and audited, with the Paper 34 product-table restoration preserved. Multilingual stream: Spanish/Japanese cumulative readers are complete through Paper 43; Paper 01 French and complete Paper 02 French pilots are also included. Source/artifact preservation: TeX, source-scan witnesses, audit notes, build logs, render checks, and glossary/methodology deltas are preserved in ZIP artifacts.

Latest update. Promotes recursive audit RA03 for Papers 07-12. This tranche checks the German scan witness first, then propagates source-visible note corrections into German control, English, Spanish, and Japanese cumulative readers. RA03 restores a missing recursive-definition footnote in Paper 09 English, five source-visible Paper 09 notes in Spanish/Japanese, and a missing Hamel linear-basis note in Paper 10 English. The RA03 ZIP preserves scan witnesses, diffs, render checks, logs, and continuation notes. The current cumulative German, English, Spanish, and Japanese PDFs report zero overfull and zero underfull hboxes.
notes: Latest update promotes recursive audit RA03 for Papers 07-12: missing source-visible footnotes were restored in English, Spanish, and Japanese cumulative readers after checking against German scan witnesses. The RA03 ZIP includes scan witnesses, diffs, render checks, logs, and continuation notes; next recursive target is Papers 13-18.
